items.text: Ŋipapae a Lepi
Arae ŋidwe a Lepi ŋulusapa lu: Gerisom ka Koas ta Merari.
Arae ŋidwe a Koas ŋulusapa lu: Amiram, Isar ka Ebiron ta Usiel.
Arae ŋidwe ka Amiram lu: Aron ka Moses ta Miriam. Arae ŋidwe ka Aron ŋulusapa lu: Nadab, Abiu,
Eleasar ka Isamar. Abu Eleasar touru Pineas, touru Pineas Abisua,
touru Abisua Buki, touru Buki Usi,
touru Usi Sakariya, touru Sakariya Merayos,
touru Merayos Amaria, touru Amaria Aitub,
touru Aitub Sadok, touru Sadok Aimas,
touru Aimas, Asaria, touru Asaria Yoanan,
touru Yoanan Asaria, (Arae Asaria etiyae ikwapei esacaradoti alo Kai ka Akuj a ŋina abu Solomon todukok Yerusalem),
touru Asaria Amaria, touru Amaria Aitub,
touru Aitub Sadok, touru Sadok Salum,
touru Salum Ilikia, touru Ilikia Asaria,
touru Asaria Seraia, ido abu Seraia touru Yeosadak.
Aponi Yeosadak torikoroe anakwap keŋ apaki ŋina eritarya Ekapolon ŋituŋa a Yudaya ka ŋulu a Yerusalem nakwapin anapedor a ŋina a Nabukednesar.
Arae ŋidwe a Lepi ŋulusapa lu: Gerisom ka Koas ta Merari.
Ŋirorwa a ŋidwe a Gerisom a ŋulusapa lu: Libini ka Simei.
Arae ŋidwe a Koas ŋulusapa ikes lu: Amiram, Isar ka Eburon ta Usiel.
Arae ŋidwe a Merari ŋulusapa lu: Mali ka Musi. Arae nu ŋatekerin a ŋilepi imarunitae aneni atapapaa kec:
Arae lu ŋituŋa a Gerisom akisyakin ananyamet ka apei tari ŋinace: Libini, Yaas, Sima.
Yoa, Idido, Sera ka Yeaserai.
Arae lu ŋituŋa a Koas akisyakin ananyamet ka apei tari ŋinace: Aminadab, Kora, Asir,
Elikana, Ebiasap, Asir,
Taas, Uriel, Usia ka Saul.
Ayakar Elikana ŋisapa ŋiarei lu: Amasai ka Aimos.
Arae lu ŋituŋa ka Aimos akisyakin ananyamet ka apei tari ŋinace: Elikana, Sopai, Naas,
Eliab, Yeroam ka Elikana.
Ayakar Samuel ŋisapa ŋiarei lu: Yoel ŋolo arae ekiyae keŋ ka ŋolo a ŋiarei arae Abiya.
Arae lu ŋituŋa a Merari akisyakin ananyamet ka apei tari ŋinace: Mali, Libini, Simei, Usa,
Simea, Agia ka Asaia.
Ŋikaeok alo Kai ka Akuj ŋulu aseuni Daudi
Ŋikilyok lu ikes abu Daudi toseu aeore alo Kai ke Ekapolon kedaun ayaun Asaduku Kai ka Akuj.
Apotu ikes toeoto alokiŋaren eema ŋolo elipere akitodol ŋina adukio Solomon Akai ŋina ke Ekapolon Yerusalem. Apotu ikes toboonokin akitiya ŋiticisyo alotooma ŋikisila ŋulu alimokinitae ikes.

Ŋikilyok lu ikes apotu kitiyata kaapei ka ŋidwe kec ŋulusapa. Arae lu Ŋikoasi: Eman ŋolo arae ekarikon ka aeore a ŋikaeok a ŋulu ke ekiŋaren, arae iŋes lokoku a Yoel, emarunitae ŋituŋa ke ekal keŋ tari neni a Yakob alopite a lo: Eman, Yoel, Samuel,
Elikana, Yeroam, Eliel, Toa,
Sup, Elikana, Maas, Amasai,
Elikana, Yoel, Asaria, Sepania,
Taas, Asir, Ebiasap, Kora,
Isar, Koas, Lepi ka Yakob.
Asap iŋes arae ekarikon ka aeore a ŋikaeok a ŋulu a ŋiarei, emarunitae ŋituŋa ke ekal keŋ tari neni a Lepi alopite a lo: Asap, Berekia, Simea,
Mikael, Baseia, Maliciya,
Esini, Sera, Adaia,
Esan, Sima, Simei,
Yaas, Gerisom ka Lepi.
Asan ŋolo arae ekanateker a Merari iŋes arae ekarikon ka aeore a ŋikaeok a ŋulu a ŋiuni, emarunitae ŋituŋa ke ekal keŋ tari neni a Lepi alopite a lo: Esan, Kisi, Abidi, Maluk,
Asabia, Amasia, Ilikia,
Amisi, Bani, Semer,
Mali, Musi ka Merari ta Lepi.
Ainakinitae ŋilepi ŋuluce ŋiticisyo ŋuluce daadaŋ anakibois a ŋina elipere alo Kai ka Akuj.

Nai arae Aron ka ŋidwe keŋ ŋulusapa ayaanarete ŋainakineta ŋuna ke ekinyate ka ŋamuronisya ŋuna epeyo Namuroet ŋina epeyere. Ikes etiyaete etic daadaŋ anakibois a ŋina asegan nooi, ikes amookununeete Ŋisirael alopite a daadaŋ a ŋolo kebu Moses eketiyan ka Akuj tolimunio.
Arae lu ŋituŋa ka ateker ka Aron: Eleasar, Pineas, Abisua,
Buki, Usi, Seraia,
Meraios, Amaria, Aitub,
Sadok ka Aimas.
Ŋakiboisyo ŋuna eboiyoto ŋilepi
Arae nu ŋakiboisyo ŋuna eboiyoto ŋilepi alopite a ŋolo alomitotor ikes ikukorosi. Keponi ŋipapae ka Aron ŋulu anateker a Koas tokorakinae akibois ŋina ke ekiŋaren, anerae keponi kisyakinae aneni kec.
Keponi tokorakinae ikes Eburon etaun ŋolo alo Yudaya ka adakar daadaŋ ŋina alodiyete Eburon,
nai ŋimanikorin ka ŋirerya ŋulu keya Eburon, keponi tokorakinae neni a Kaleb alokoku a Yepune.
Aŋun, keponi tokorakinae ŋiletok ka Aron ŋitaunio lu: Eburon (iŋes atemar etaun ŋolo eiunor ituŋanan), Libina, Yatir, Esitemoa,
Ilen, Debir,
Asan, Yuta ka Bes-Semes kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
Keponi tokorakinae ateker a Benjamin ŋitaunio lu: Gibeon, Geba, Alemes ka Anasos, kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec. Arae ŋitaunio a ŋatekerin a Ŋikoasi daadaŋ ŋitomon ka ŋiuni.
Aponi Ŋikaosi ŋuluce daadaŋ tokorakinae ŋitaunio ŋitomon anatutubet ka apei a ŋina a ekabila a Manase.

Keponi ŋiletok a Gerisom a ŋinateker tokorakinae ŋitaunio ŋitomon ka ŋiuni alokabilae a lu: A ŋolo a Isakar, a ŋolo a Aser ka a ŋolo a Naputali ta anatutubet ka apei a ŋina a ekabila a Manase alo Basan.
Keponi ŋiletok a Merari a ŋinateker tokorakinae ŋitaunio ŋitomon ka ŋiarei alokabilae a lu: A ŋolo a Ruben ka a ŋolo a Gad ta a ŋolo a Sebulon.
Ŋitaunio ŋul ikes apotu Ŋisirael tokorakis ŋituŋa a Lepi, inakis kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
Apotu daŋ Ŋisirael tokorakis ŋilepi ŋitaunio ŋice ŋulu imarunitae alokabilae a lu: A ŋolo a Yuda ka a ŋolo a Simeon ta a ŋolo a Benjamin.
Keponi tokorakinae ŋatekerin a Ŋikaosi ŋace ŋitaunio kec bon alokabila ke Epuraim.
Anakwap ke Epuraim a ŋina elalak ŋikamukumukui, keponi tokorakinae ikes ŋitaunio lu: Sekem (iŋes etaun eiunor ituŋanan), Geser,
Yokimeam, Bes-Oron,
Aijalon ka Gas-Rimon kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
Kepotu Ŋisirael tokorakis Ŋikoasi ŋuluce daadaŋ anatutubet ka apei a ŋina a ekabila a Manase ŋitaunio lu: Aner ka Beleam kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
Kepotu Ŋisirael tokorakis Ŋigerisoni ŋitaunio lu anatutubet ka apei a ŋina a ekabila a Manase: Golan alo Basan ka Asitaros kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec;
kepotu toryamut alokabila a Isakar ŋitaunio lu: Kedec, Dabera,
Ramos ka Anem kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec;
kepotu toryamut alokabila ka Aser ŋitaunio lu: Masal, Abidon,
Ukok ka Reob kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec;
ido kepotu toryamut alokabila a Naputali ŋitaunio lu: Kedec alo Galileya, Amon ka Kiriasaim kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
Kepotu Ŋimerari (ŋilepi ŋuluce daadaŋ) toryamut ŋitaunio lu alokabila a Sebulon: Yokineam, Karita ka Rimono ta Tabor kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec;
alokabila a Ruben alo Kide Yorodan ka Kide Yeriko, kepotu toryamut ŋitaunio lu: Beser analoŋisat, Yasa,
Kedemos ka Mepaas kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
Alokabila a Gad, kepotu toryamut ŋitaunio lu: Ramos alo Gilead, Manaim,
Esibon ka Yaser kaapei ka ŋadakarisinei kec.
